传输缓存不是普通文件。: The transfer cache is not a regular file.
上传分片断点无效。: The saved upload checkpoint is invalid.
下载分段与请求的文件范围不符。: The download response does not match the requested byte range.
输入 Cloudreve 站点地址，在浏览器中完成授权。: Enter your Cloudreve site address, then authorize access in your browser.
目标文件夹（相对于授权目录，/ 表示根目录）: Destination relative to the authorized folder (/ for its root)
将「{0}」移到云端回收站？此更改也会同步到配对目录。: Move “{0}” to cloud trash? This also affects the paired folder.
每行一条，例如 *.tmp 或 build/。清空后恢复同步。: One pattern per line, for example *.tmp or build/. Clear the rules to include those paths again.
无法打开系统浏览器。: The default browser could not be opened.
没有与此回调匹配的授权，请在对应的云盘窗口重新连接。: No authorization matches this callback. Reconnect from the correct drive window.
没有等待中的授权，请先在应用中连接云盘。: No pending authorization. Connect a drive in the app first.
远端目录有变更，刷新可查看。: The cloud folder changed. Refresh to see updates.
已恢复变更通知，刷新可查看断线期间的变更。: Change notifications resumed. Refresh to see changes you missed.
无法订阅变更，可手动刷新或重新授权。: Cannot watch for changes. Refresh manually or authorize again.
无法连接服务器，请检查网络。: Cannot reach the server. Check your network connection.
请求失败（HTTP {0}），请检查站点及授权。: Request failed (HTTP {0}). Check the site and authorization.
请求已取消或超时。: The request was cancelled or timed out.
请在系统浏览器中完成站点授权。: Finish authorizing the site in your browser.
选择与当前云端目录双向同步的本地文件夹: Choose a local folder to sync with this cloud folder
{0} 项未覆盖，请查看配对状态。: Items left unchanged: {0}. Check the folder pair for details.
同步未完成，将自动重试：: Sync did not finish and will retry:
云端已有同名项目，未覆盖。请更名后上传。: A cloud item already has this name. Rename the file and upload again.
本地已删除。保留本地会将云端文件移入回收站；保留云端会重新下载。: Deleted locally. Keep local moves the cloud file to trash; keep cloud downloads it again.
云端已删除。保留本地会重新上传；保留云端会把本地文件移入恢复目录。: Deleted in the cloud. Keep local uploads the file again; keep cloud moves the local file to recovery.
保留两份会把本地版本另存为 local-copy 文件，并将云端版本保留在原路径: Keep both saves the local version as a local-copy file and restores the cloud version at the original path.
登录时打开：前往系统设置批准…: Open at login: approve in System Settings…
请在 macOS 13 或更高版本从已安装的 Cloudreve.app 管理登: Manage login items from the installed Cloudreve.app on macOS 13 or later.
macOS 未更改登录项，请在系统设置的登录项中检查。: macOS did not change the login item. Check Login Items in System Settings.
请从发布包中的 CloudreveClient.exe 管理开机自启。: Manage startup from CloudreveClient.exe in the release package.
Windows 未更改开机自启设置，请在“设置 > 应用 > 启动”中检查。: Windows did not change the startup setting. Check Settings > Apps > Startup.
设置必须是普通文件。: Preferences must be a regular file.
本机登录文件格式无效，请重新连接云盘。: Invalid local session file. Reconnect the drive.
本机登录记录无效，请重新连接云盘。: Invalid saved session. Reconnect the drive.
登录配置必须是普通文件，不能是链接。: The session must be a regular file, not a link.
登录配置目录不能是链接或普通文件。: The session directory cannot be a link or a regular file.
请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的站点根地址，不要包含账号、: Enter an http:// or https:// site root without credentials, a subpath, a query or a fragment.
桌面连接需要 Cloudreve 4.12.0 或更高版本。: Desktop connections require Cloudreve 4.12.0 or later.
站点未批准本次授权。: The site did not approve authorization.
回调与当前授权不匹配或已过期。: The callback does not match this authorization or has expired.
授权回调缺少有效云端目录。: The authorization callback has no valid cloud folder.
本次授权回调已使用。: This authorization callback has already been used.
授权回调与服务器账号不匹配。: The callback does not match the server account.
重新授权必须选择原账号与原目录；更换云盘请先断开连接。: Authorize the original account and folder again, or disconnect first to switch drives.
服务端重复返回同一分页位置。: The server repeated a pagination position.
读取期间目录已变化。: The folder changed while it was being read.
目录列表不完整，请稍后重试。: Incomplete folder listing. Try again later.
站点未提供目录事件流，可手动刷新。: The site has no folder event stream. Refresh manually.
站点未返回可用的下载地址。: The site did not return a usable download URL.
下载内容超过预期大小。: Downloaded content exceeds the expected size.
文件大小已变化或下载不完整，请刷新后重试。: The file size changed or the download was incomplete. Refresh and try again.
无法确认配对的云端目录。: Could not verify the paired cloud folder.
配对目录不能与其他云盘的配对目录或应用配置目录重叠。: The paired folder cannot overlap another pair or the app settings folder.
同步目录不能包含应用的设置目录。: The sync folder cannot contain the app settings folder.
请先停止原目录配对。: Stop the existing folder pair first.
本地同步目录已移动、被替换或磁盘未挂载；未同步。: The local root moved, was replaced, or is not mounted. Sync stopped.
同步目录不存在，或路径包含链接。: The sync folder is missing or its path contains a link.
忽略规则不能超过 32 KiB 字符。: Ignore rules cannot exceed 32 Ki characters.
忽略规则无效。可使用 *、?、**、/ 和开头的 !，不支持字符组或转义。: Invalid ignore rule. Use *, ?, **, / or a leading !. Character classes and escapes are not supported.
同步目录包含无法安全映射的文件名。: The sync folder contains a name that cannot be mapped safely.
扫描期间本地目录已变化。: The local folder changed during the scan.
云端条目不属于正在同步的目录。: A cloud entry is outside the folder being synchronized.
无法验证云端文件版本。: Could not verify the cloud file version.
无法确认远端文件版本，未覆盖。请刷新目录。: Could not verify the cloud version. Nothing was overwritten. Refresh the folder.
站点返回了无效的分片大小。: The site returned an invalid chunk size.
上传分片与站点返回的地址不匹配。: Upload chunks do not match the URLs returned by the site.
站点未返回上传地址。: The site did not return an upload URL.
该文件不支持使用 {0} 策略上传。: Storage policy {0} does not support uploading this file.
存储服务缺少分片 ETag。: The storage service did not return a chunk ETag.
存储服务未能合并分片。: The storage service could not complete the multipart upload.
上传期间源文件被截短。: The source file was truncated during upload.
站点要求的加密算法不受支持；未发送文件内容。: The requested encryption algorithm is not supported. No file content was sent.
上传加密参数无效；未发送文件内容。: Invalid upload encryption parameters. No file content was sent.
配对的云端目录已被替换；请核对后重新配对。: The paired cloud root was replaced. Verify it before pairing again.
云端名称冲突或条目类型已变化。: Cloud names collide or the entry type changed.
云端文件在同步期间已变化。: The cloud file changed during sync.
云端文件在同步期间已变化，将重新扫描。: The cloud file changed during sync. It will be scanned again.
云端父目录在同步期间已变化。: The cloud parent folder changed during sync.
云端父目录已被文件替换。: A file replaced the cloud parent folder.
本地文件在同步期间已变化，将重新扫描。: The local file changed during sync. It will be scanned again.
云端回读与上传前的文件内容不同，未记录为已同步。: Cloud read-back differs from the original. The file was not marked as synced.
冲突记录不属于当前配对。: This conflict does not belong to the current pair.
此路径已被忽略，未处理。: This path is ignored. No action was taken.
只有两端都存在的普通文件才能保留两份。: Keep both requires a regular file on both sides.
本地副本将被忽略，未处理。: The local copy would be ignored. No action was taken.
本地文件已变化，未覆盖。: The local file changed. Nothing was overwritten.
上传回读与本地内容不一致，未记录为已解决。: Upload read-back differs from the local file. The conflict was not marked as resolved.
移动期间本地文件已被替换。: The local file was replaced during the move.
本地目录在同步期间已变化。: The local folder changed during sync.
无法确认新建的云端目录。: Could not verify the newly created cloud folder.
云端目录在同步期间已变化。: The cloud folder changed during sync.
